en.html:
Koga Liaison《Koga lordship headquarters. Occupation forces have broken through our air defences. They are overhead and the bombing has begun.》
Koga Liaison《Air superiority is with the enemy at present. It appears they mean to bomb away our defensive capability, then attack with the ground forces now approaching.》
Koga Liaison《Sending troops to help Fudaraku is not possible from our side!》

en.html:
Fleet Adjutant"Bunkers and gun batteries almost entirely silenced. Shoreline obstacles cleared in the required areas also!"
Fleet Commander"Good. Send in the LST tank-landing ships. Dragoons down. Suppress the positions still holding out."
Fleet Adjutant"Yes, sir."
Fleet Commander"Begin the landing!"

艦隊副官「防御点バンカー、砲台、ほぼ沈黙しました。 　水際障害物も所要範囲の駆逐は完了！」
艦隊司令「よろしい。戦車揚陸艦ＬＳＴを出せ。 　竜騎兵ドラグーンは降下させろ。残存ポイントの制圧 だ」
艦隊副官「はっ」
艦隊司令「上陸を開始する!!」
